Target company: Apple (AAPL). Apple develops and sells personal computing devices including iPhone, Mac and iPad, with operating systems and digital services.

Focal announcement: Apple Battersea opens in London’s historic Battersea Power Station.

Decision cutoff: 2023-06-15T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Apple Battersea opens in London’s historic Battersea Power Station. Published date: 2023-06-15. URL: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2023/06/apple-battersea-opens-in-londons-historic-battersea-power-station.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Apple today opened Apple Battersea inside the historic Battersea Power Station in London. Apple Battersea has highly skilled and deeply knowledgeable team members who are ready to deliver best-in-class service to customers who want to purchase and learn more about the latest Apple products, including the all-new 15-inch MacBook Air — the world’s best 15-inch laptop — and Mac Studio with M2 Max and M2 Ultra. In celebration of the opening of Apple Battersea, Apple Music will host live performances outside the store from Thursday through Sunday, featuring local artists JGrrey and Kwaye, among others. Additionally, in partnership with Battersea Arts Centre and Curated Makers, Apple Creatives have supported eight local emerging creatives to bring Shot on iPhone and Made on iPad works to life, all inspired by Battersea Power Station. Customers will be able to discover and shop these works at Curated Makers, a retailer in the power station that champions local artists.
